name: Which Monday? - Date Clarification
description: Scenario where callee asks 'which Monday?' Tests that agent does NOT convert to calendar date but instead asks for clarification or restates 'next Monday'.
goal: Get the store hours for next Monday

transcript.speaker: assistant
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Pigeon, an AI assistant calling on behalf of the owner. I'm calling to find out your store hours for next Monday.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Which Monday? Do you mean tomorrow or the Monday after?
